request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:RAIDER

layers.text: Recolour only the goblin rider's skin: his face, ears, chest, belly, arms and hands become olive green, colour #8a952f with #495508 shadows, a little darker and less yellow than now; the face stays clearly visible. Do not touch the wolf. Keep everything else exactly the same: the brown leather cap, strap and saddle blanket, the spear, the grey wolf, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
